items.stem: State any three points of importance of controlling.
items.answer: Accomplishing organisational goals; Judging accuracy of standards; Making efficient use of resources; Improving employee motivation; Ensuring order and discipline; Facilitating coordination in action
items.markingKey: Any three of: Accomplishing organisational goals; Judging accuracy of standards; Making efficient use of resources; Improving employee motivation; Ensuring order and discipline; Facilitating coordination in action (1 mark each).

items.stem: Which of the following is true of planning but not of controlling?
items.answer: Nature: prescriptive
items.markingKey: (d) planning: Nature: prescriptive. The other options describe controlling.
options: Focus: ensuring that performance matches the plan

items.stem: Distinguish between planning and controlling on the basis of nature, sequence, time orientation and focus.
items.answer: (i) Nature: planning: prescriptive; controlling: evaluative. (ii) Sequence: planning: the first function; controlling: the last function. (iii) Time orientation: planning: looks ahead; controlling: looks back (and ahead). (iv) Focus: planning: setting goals and deciding the course of action; controlling: ensuring that performance matches the plan.
items.markingKey: 1 mark for each basis: (i) Nature: planning: prescriptive; controlling: evaluative. (ii) Sequence: planning: the first function; controlling: the last function. (iii) Time orientation: planning: looks ahead; controlling: looks back (and ahead). (iv) Focus: planning: setting goals and deciding the course of action; controlling: ensuring that performance matches the plan.

items.stem: Joshi Industries found it hard to fix a numerical standard for employee morale. Which point of importance or limitation of controlling is highlighted?
items.answer: Difficulty in setting quantitative standards
items.markingKey: (a) Difficulty in setting quantitative standards. Some areas cannot be measured numerically.

items.stem: A sudden change in import duties hurt Reddy Brothers and its control system could do nothing about it. Which point of importance or limitation of controlling is highlighted? Justify your answer.
items.answer: Little control on external factors. External factors cannot be controlled.
items.markingKey: 1 mark for identifying Little control on external factors; 2 marks for the justification: External factors cannot be controlled.

items.stem:
Goyal Stores set a target of reducing defects in handloom sarees to 2%. Its managers regularly compare actual defects with the target and act on deviations. Workers now know exactly what is expected and work more carefully.
(i) Identify the function and two points of its importance in the case. (ii) How is it related to planning?
items.answer: (i) Controlling; accomplishing goals; improving employee motivation (also efficient use of resources). (ii) Planning sets the target (standard); controlling checks performance against it; they are inseparable twins.
items.markingKey: 4 marks: (i) Controlling; accomplishing goals; improving employee motivation (also efficient use of resources). (ii) Planning sets the target (standard); controlling checks performance against it; they are inseparable twins.

Controlling is not needed if planning is good.
